title: LTX 2.3 Enhancers: Crisp and Soft detail LoRAs for text-to-video
summary: Two detail LoRAs for LTX 2.3 text-to-video. Soft Enhance adds subtle detail, improves clarity and softens the strong contrast of LTX 2.3; Crisp Enhance is the sharper one. The page links the author's text-to-video workflow: swap in the LoRA and the prompt.
